items.title: 14.8.1 Hawa ke mayar par asar dalne wale awamil (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.8.1, printed pages 314-315.

items: Ikhraj ke zaraye: lakri aur fossil fuels jalana maqami aaloodgi barhata hai; factories aur bijli ghar SOx aur NOx chhorte hain, gariyan CO, PM aur VOCs.

Mausamiyati halaat: hawa, darja hararat aur nami pollutants ke phailne aur concentration par asar dalte hain; zameen ke qareeb pollutants ko rokne wali garam hawa ki tah (inversion) kharab hawa ka sabab ban sakti hai.
Qudrati waqiat: jangal ki aag dhuen aur PM ki bari miqdar chhorti hai; dhool ke toofan hawa ka mayar khasa gira sakte hain.
Mausami tabdeeliyan: mukhtalif mausamon mein imarton ko garam ya thanda karna ikhraj barhata hai, aur mausami pollen kharab hawa mein izafa karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa qudrati aamil hawa ka mayar behtar kar sakta hai, aur us par asar dalne wale awamil bayan karein (MCQ IV; exercise Q.6)?
blocks.explanation: Barish zarraat aur halne wali gases ko hawa se dho kar hawa ka mayar behtar karti hai. Hawa ka mayar ikhraj ke zaraye (fuel jalna, sanat, traffic), mausamiyat (hawa phailati hai, sakin hawa aur darja hararat ke inversions pollutants rokte hain), qudrati waqiat (jangal ki aag, dhool ke toofan) aur mausamon (garam aur thanda karne ki zaroorat, pollen) par munhasir hai.

items: Awamil: ikhraj ke zaraye; mausamiyat (hawa, darja hararat, nami, inversions); qudrati waqiat (jangal ki aag, dhool ke toofan); mausami tabdeeliyan (garam, thanda karna, pollen).
